package.description: Secure local-first MFA token manager for Windows with encrypted vault, GUI, CLI, agent, and MCP surfaces.

en-US.description: Secure local-first MFA token manager for Windows with encrypted vault, GUI, CLI, agent, and MCP surfaces.
en-US.longDescription: MFA-Forge is a secure MFA token manager written in Rust. It provides a Windows desktop GUI, a human CLI, a local agent session over stdio, a minimal local MCP server over stdio, and an encrypted local vault with bounded audit and reporting flows.
en-US.name: MFA-Forge
